## Current roles

- Coordinator of [TwinRISE](https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101287548), Horizon Europe project on trusted AI-generated digital twins for research infrastructures (2027 to 2030).
- Co-creator and coordinator of the [ARTIFACT](https://artifact-network.org) network, more than forty European partners.
- Work-package lead in iRIS.
- Coordinator of M4CAST, the French network on AI for accelerators (since 2022), and of the CNRS master project MLAcc.
- In charge of AI developments for the GANIL accelerator division (since 2024).
- In charge of collective effects for the [FCC-ee](https://home.cern/science/accelerators/future-circular-collider) high energy booster (since 2023).
- Expert for the European Commission, MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships physics panel. Reviewer and guest editor (Physical Review, Springer Nature, Frontiers in Physics).
